source: SFMTA Performance / Transtat (Tableau) - "Average daily Muni boardings by route and month (pre-pandemic to present)" and "Muni ridership: average weekday ridership"
period: 2026-09 (latest month published; primary field avgWeekdayBoardings). Also last-12-month mean 2025-10..2026-09, CY2025 mean, CY2019 mean.
notes: Source definition: average daily boardings for the month = SUM(monthly total boardings for Weekday) / COUNT(weekdays in month). Based on automatic passenger counter (APC) data; SFMTA states it does NOT include historic streetcar (E, F) or cable car ridership. Values are published rounded (to nearest 100 for most routes). "Reported results are subject to change as data quality improves."
avgWeekdayBoardings, avgSaturdayBoardings, avgSundayBoardings, weekdayByMonth: copied verbatim from the source CSV.

avgWeekdayBoardings_last12moMean / _cy2025Mean / _cy2019Mean_preCOVID are DERIVED here: unweighted arithmetic mean of the published monthly weekday averages (months with blank values skipped; count of months used is given). They are not SFMTA-published figures.

route = leading token of the source label (e.g. "38R Geary Rapid" -> "38R"), which matches SFMTA GTFS route_short_name for current routes. Rail lines are labelled by letter (J, K, L, M, N, T) as in GTFS. KT Ingleside/Third was reported combined until 2025-03 and is in historicRoutes; K and T are reported separately for the latest months.

Routes with no current weekday data (cable cars PH/PM/CA, F Market & Wharves, E Embarcadero, suspended express routes, KT, 21 Hayes, S Shuttle) are listed in historicRoutes with their last reported value and CY2019 mean.
714 BART Early Bird weekday values are blank in the source for the latest month.
avgSaturday/SundayBoardings_last12moMean: mean of the monthly Saturday/Sunday averages 2025-10..2026-09 from the same CSV, matching the weekday 12-month mean (added 2026-10-04).

systemwide.source: SFMTA "Muni ridership: average weekday ridership" (Transtat Goal2Dashboards RidershipTable)
systemwide.definition: Average weekday boardings by transportation mode (APC on buses, traffic checkers on rail). System total = sum over modes, per SFMTA methodology "sum([average weekday ridership])". Includes Cable Car and Historic modes. Totals below are summed here from the published mode rows.
systemwide.note: Systemwide series ends earlier than the by-route series (latest month 2026-06). Sum of route-level avgWeekdayBoardings for 2026-09 (excludes cable car + historic streetcar) = 534000.
